

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

col_pla_env = c("#7B9DBB", "#EFB04B")

col_pla_other = c("#8FB4DC", "#EFB04B")

col_location = c("#ECD1D1", "#7B9DBB")

kingdom_colors <- c("bacteria" = "#ECD1D1", "fungi" = "#ABD7EC", "alage" = "#FFDD8E")

```


```{r}
data <- read.csv("qPCR_fold_change.csv")

order_list <- c("Bacteria", "Fungi", "Algae")
data$Kingdom <- factor(data$Kingdom, levels = order_list)

summary_results <- data %>%
  group_by(Kingdom) %>%
  do({
    values <- .$Value
    
    w <- wilcox.test(values,
                     mu = 1,
                     conf.int = TRUE,
                     conf.level = 0.95,
                     exact = FALSE)
    tibble(
      median      = median(values),
      min         = min(values),
      max         = max(values),
      hl_estimate = unname(w$estimate),   
      ci_low      = w$conf.int[1],        
      ci_high     = w$conf.int[2],       
      p_value     = w$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "Median = ", round(median, 2),
      "\nMin = ", round(min, 2),
      ", Max = ", round(max, 2),
      "\nHL 95% CI: ", round(ci_low, 2), "–", round(ci_high, 2)
    )
  )

summary_results$Kingdom <- factor(summary_results$Kingdom, levels = order_list)

p1a <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Kingdom, y = Value)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(1, 1e3, 1e6)) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    position = position_quasirandom(method = "pseudorandom"),
    color = "#EFB04B",
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    shape = 19
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    data = summary_results,
    aes(x = Kingdom, y = hl_estimate, ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
    color = "black",
    size = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = summary_results,
    aes(x = Kingdom, y = max(data$Value) * 1.05, label = label),
    size = 2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    size = 0.2,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = summary_results,
    aes(
      x = Kingdom,
      y = max(data$Value) / 3,
      label = paste("p =", signif(p_value, 3))
    ),
    size = 2,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text       = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5)
  )


p1a

```



#risk_subtype comparison 
```{r}
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(boot)

data3 <- read.csv("fold_change.csv")

order_list <- c("Pathogenic_bacteria", "Pathogenic_fungi", "Toxic_algae", "ARGs")
data3$Risk_type <- factor(data3$Risk_type, levels = order_list)

summary_results <- data3 %>%
  group_by(Risk_type) %>%
  do({
    values <- .$Value
    w <- wilcox.test(values,
                     mu = 1,
                     conf.int = TRUE,
                     conf.level = 0.95,
                     exact = FALSE) 
    
    tibble(
      median      = median(values),
      min         = min(values),
      max         = max(values),
      hl_estimate = unname(w$estimate),   
      ci_low      = w$conf.int[1],       
      ci_high     = w$conf.int[2],  
      p_value     = w$p.value
    )}) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "Median = ", round(median, 2),
      "\nMin = ", round(min, 2),
      ", Max = ", round(max, 2),
      "\nHL 95% CI: ", round(ci_low, 2), "–", round(ci_high, 2)))

summary_results$Risk_type <- factor(summary_results$Risk_type, levels = order_list)

p1b <- ggplot(data3, aes(x = Risk_type, y = Value)) +
  
  geom_quasirandom(
    position = position_quasirandom(method = "pseudorandom"),
    color = "#EFB04B",
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    shape = 19
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    data = summary_results,
    aes(
      x = Risk_type,
      y = hl_estimate, 
      ymin = ci_low,
      ymax = ci_high
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = summary_results,
    aes(
      x = Risk_type,
      y = max(data3$Value) * 0.3,  
      label = label
    ),
    size = 2,
    color = "black") +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    size = 0.2,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "black") +
  geom_text(
    data = summary_results,
    aes(
      x = Risk_type,
      y = max(data3$Value) - 5,   
      label = paste("p =", signif(p_value, 3))),
    size = 2,
    vjust = 0) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    y = "Fold change (plastisphere / ambient)",
    x = "Microbial risk category"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white", size = 0.5)
  )

p1b

# ggsave(plot = p1, "overall_risk_difference.pdf", width = 90, height = 150, units = "mm")

```


#fig1b1
```{r}
# 读取数据
pathogen_data <- read.csv("bac_pathogen_type_abundance.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# 分离分组列和丰度列
metadata <- pathogen_data["Habitat"]
abundance_data <- pathogen_data[, !colnames(pathogen_data) %in% "Habitat"]


# 1. 计算每类致病菌丰度的均值
summary_data <- abundance_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Pathogen_Type", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  group_by(Pathogen_Type) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Abundance))

summary_data$Pathogen_Type <- factor(summary_data$Pathogen_Type, levels = rev(unique(summary_data$Pathogen_Type)))

stacked_bar_plot1 <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = 1, y = mean, fill = Pathogen_Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFF8E8", "#EEF6FB", "#CEEFEA")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0))


stacked_bar_plot1

```



```{r}
normalized_data <- abundance_data %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ (. - min(.)) / (max(.) - min(.))))

normalized_data$Habitat <- metadata$Habitat

wilcox_results <- normalized_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Habitat, names_to = "Pathogen_Type", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Pathogen_Type) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Value ~ Habitat, paired = TRUE, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(level = case_when(
    p.adj < 0.05 & estimate < 0 ~ "enriched",
    p.adj < 0.05 & estimate > 0 ~ "depleted",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

point_line_plot1 <- ggplot(wilcox_results, aes(x = Pathogen_Type)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = -conf.low, ymin = -conf.high, color = level)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = -estimate, color = level), size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = -conf.low, label = p.adj.signif, color = level), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#EFB04B", "#B6BBBD", "#7B9DBB"),
                     limits = c("enriched", "ns", "depleted")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey") +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0))

point_line_plot1

```

# Richness
```{r}

# 读取数据
pathogen_data <- read.csv("bac_pathogen_type_richness.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# 分离分组列和丰度列
metadata <- pathogen_data["Habitat"]
Richness_data <- pathogen_data[, !colnames(pathogen_data) %in% "Habitat"]


# 1. 计算每类致病菌丰度的均值
summary_data <- Richness_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Pathogen_Type", values_to = "Richness") %>%
  group_by(Pathogen_Type) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Richness))

summary_data$Pathogen_Type <- factor(summary_data$Pathogen_Type, levels = rev(unique(summary_data$Pathogen_Type)))


# 绘制堆叠柱状图
stacked_bar_plot1 <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = 1, y = mean, fill = Pathogen_Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFF8E8", "#EEF6FB", "#CEEFEA")) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0))


stacked_bar_plot1

```


```{r}

# 2. 丰度比较和点线图
# 进行0-1标准化
normalized_data <- Richness_data %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ (. - min(.)) / (max(.) - min(.))))

# 添加分组信息
normalized_data$Habitat <- metadata$Habitat

# 差异比较
wilcox_results <- normalized_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Habitat, names_to = "Pathogen_Type", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Pathogen_Type) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(Value ~ Habitat, paired = TRUE, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(level = case_when(
    p.adj < 0.05 & estimate < 0 ~ "enriched",
    p.adj < 0.05 & estimate > 0 ~ "depleted",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))


# 点线图绘制
point_line_plot1 <- ggplot(wilcox_results, aes(x = Pathogen_Type)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymax = -conf.low, ymin = -conf.high, color = level)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = -estimate, color = level), size = 2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = -conf.low, label = p.adj.signif, color = level), vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#EFB04B", "#B6BBBD", "#7B9DBB"),
                     limits = c("enriched", "ns", "depleted")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, size = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey") +
  
  coord_flip() + # 旋转坐标系
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        # axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0))

point_line_plot1

```

```{r}
p1d_i <- plot_grid(p1d_f, p1g_i, nrow = 2)

p1d_i

ggsave(plot = p1d_i, "Figure1d_i.pdf", width = 180, height = 120, units = c("mm"))


```
